Your 60 minutes

Three things
you’ll leave with.

A practical starting point for your first tech UGC campaign, with time to ask questions before you leave.

01

A way to evaluate your first deal.0–15 minutes · Deals & pricing

Understand per-video fees, deliverables, and view-bonus terms. We’ll use the $30–$50 video deals in our experience to explain what to look for before you commit.

02

A repeatable production workflow.15–30 minutes · From brief to posted

See how we organize filming, work with editors, create variations, and schedule posts. Leave knowing how those steps fit together before you take on more campaigns.

03

A plan for testing and tracking.30–45 minutes · Accounts & performance

Know which account and video results to review, how to choose the next content test, and how to keep track of deliverables and bonus thresholds. Views and bonuses aren’t guaranteed.

Final 15 minutes: An introduction to our optional six-month paid mentorship, followed by live Q&A. You can attend the free class without joining the program.
